title: Refuse deliver when main checkout holds untracked paths the PR adds
body:
Evidence: PR #151 delivery 2026-10-31. An untracked tasks/t-jfvmmcq.json in the main checkout (task recorded but never committed) would make deliver hygiene's `git merge --ff-only origin/main` fail after the merge; the lead removed it by hand.
Acceptance: `krn deliver --dry-run` fails at a named stage when an untracked or ignored main-checkout path collides with a path the PR adds; a test with such a file is red at the base by assertion.
